verification_contracts: strong claims consume a fresh assurance packet frozen before the candidate existed and hidden from the proposer; every peek spends a declared exposure budget and an exhausted budget forces a new frozen packet; matched resources, hostile near-misses and negative controls ship inside the packet, never after outcomes

transition_semantics: benchmark lifecycle PACKET_FROZEN -> DEVELOPMENT_EVAL (visible, repeatable) -> FRESH_ASSURANCE (hidden, budgeted) -> {ASSURED | REJECTED | META_OVERFIT | CANNOT_CHECK}; the evaluator is frozen within an evaluation epoch and evaluator evolution is a separately governed parent mutation at an epoch boundary, benchmarked before prospective use

failure_signatures: failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:assurance-leakage - fresh packet contents visible to the optimizer before judgment
failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:ruler-rewrite - the evaluator changes inside the epoch that judges the candidate
failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:resource-mismatch - a challenger beats its parent on unequal budgets
failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:retrospective-calibration - results predating their packet presented as preregistered
falsifiers: show that a packet's freeze timestamp does not precede the candidate's construction; one such case voids the claim class
